blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Intraplate earthquakes originate within the interior of tectonic plates rather than at boundaries.
They are driven by stress transmission or the reactivation of ancient fault lines.
Because affected areas rarely prepare for seismic activity, these events often result in severe destruction.
The 2001 Bhuj earthquake serves as a primary example of an intraplate earthquake.
Remember that intraplate earthquakes occur WITHIN plate interiors, not along plate margins.
Reactivation of ancient faults and stress transmission are key causative mechanisms tested in geography exams.
The 2001 Bhuj earthquake is a crucial Indian case study for intraplate seismic hazards.
